title: Exposing the Gmail "Zero-Day" Behind Remus Stealer's Email Interception Feature
description: Remus Stealer's claimed Gmail zero-day is not an actual vulnerability but a malicious Chrome extension disguised as Google Sheets. This extension silently installs in victims' browsers, leveraging Gmail's Atom feed and attachment view endpoints to exfiltrate email content every minute. It manipulates Chrome preferences to enable Developer Mode and persist access while the user remains signed into Gmail. Access ends when the user signs out or sessions are revoked.
